subject: Embedded MAP: Safeguard stitch plan for staged migration & training
messages:
From: Elise Turner <elise.turner@mediforge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodelabs.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@mediforge.com>, Samir Qureshi <samir.qureshi@cloudworks.io>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -0000
Subject: Post-signature: sketching the embedded MAP and training windows

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the quick start call earlier. As we close, procurement asked for a concise mutual action plan that nests the implementation milestones (rollout, canary, migration waves, and the training cadence) inside the signed SOW. Would you be able to share a single-page MAP + a short canary checklist we can attach to the contract?

Key constraints from our side:
- 3-week blackout window in early July (security patching) where no infra changes allowed
- Primary pilot users are in UK time; training sessions must consider 09:00–12:00 BST windows
- We need evidence of a fallback plan if performance drops during the canary

Would appreciate a version we can share with Procurement and our CTO.

Thanks,
Elise
Director, Implementation — Mediforge

[Attachment requested: MAP outline]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elise Turner <elise.turner@mediforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Qureshi <samir.qureshi@cloudworks.io>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-signature: sketching the embedded MAP and training windows

Elise —

Appreciate the clarity. I attached a compact MAP (MAP_v1_Mediforge.pdf) and a concise canary checklist (Canary-checklist.xlsx). High-level notes below; the attached MAP embeds the timelines and owners so Procurement can slot it into the SOW appendix.

Summary highlights:
- Week 0 (Jul 5): Prep & dry-run (no infra-change work inside Mediforge blackout) — config validation, credential handoff, and test dataset smoke run. Owner: Marissa (Delivery Lead).
- Week 1 (Jul 12): Canary wave 1 — 2% production traffic routed, latency and error SLOs monitored. Auto-fallback to staging model on anomaly. Owner: Karthik (Platform).
- Week 2–3 (Jul 19–Jul 30): Expand to wave 2 (10%) then wave 3 (50%) with runbook checks at each gate, paired trainings for pilot admins (two 45-min remote sessions timed for 09:00–11:00 BST).
- Week 4 (Aug 2): Cutover & hypercare — final migration window and 2-week hypercare.

Fallback & assurance:
- Automatic routing policy to fallback model variant when token latency >350ms or error rate >1.5% for 5 minutes
- Snapshot logs + audit export to customer S3 every hour during canary (for your compliance team)

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa to run a 30-min alignment call with Mediforge ops next Tue to confirm blackout gating.
2) Karthik to attach the kernel-level perf baseline report for the pilot model (will add to the Drive link).
3) You to confirm Procurement fine with the SOW appendix language; we can convert MAP_v1 into an appendix that gets referenced in the SOW.

I can move the blackout-sensitive prep earlier if you prefer — flagged in the PDF as "read-only" for legal.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1_Mediforge.pdf (PDF, 230KB); Canary-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elise Turner <elise.turner@mediforge.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Qureshi <samir.qureshi@cloudworks.io>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-signature: sketching the embedded MAP and training windows

Quick note from Delivery:

We validated the 2% -> 10% -> 50% ramp pattern against expected concurrency from the pilot group and it looks safe provided we enforce the per-route batching limits in the doc. Two operational asks for Mediforge before Week 1:
- Confirm a single service account with write permissions to the S3 bucket for hourly audit exports
- Provide 48-hr advance notice for any maintenance inside your UK region during the canary window (so we can pause traffic flips)

Proposed alignment call: Tue 2027-06-29 15:00 UTC (09:00 BST). If that works for you Elise, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

-Marissa
Head of Delivery, Redwood Inference

From: Elise Turner <elise.turner@mediforge.com>

Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 08:10:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-signature: sketching the embedded MAP and training windows

Thanks — Tue 15:00 UTC works. Procurement reviewed the MAP appendix and had two micro edits:
1) Add explicit callout that rollback to prior model has a documented responsibility matrix (who initiates, who verifies)
2) Include a short sign-off gate for the pilot admin training completion (simple checklist)

I'll confirm service account ownership with infra and send the procurement sign-off once those two items are in the appendix.

-Elise
